name: p25 triple membrane-spanning protein
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and this is the reason this module exists separately. The ICTV profile records that MrGV lacks the triple-membrane-spanning p25 at the N-terminus of its precursor glycoprotein. ABSENT here confirms no okavirus cleavage rule has leaked into this module.

name: px / ORFX
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The ICTV profile states ORFX is absent from MrGV.

name: gp116 / gp64 cleavage products
note: NOT DECLARED, and recorded as a gap. ICTV asserts MrGV ORF3 encodes homologues of gp116 and gp64, but no cleavage site is published for MrGV and the okavirus sites cannot be transferred -- measured here, MrGV ORF3 against YHV pp3 gives a best HSP of 20.4 bits at 23.7% identity over 38 residues, which is noise.

name: ORF4
note: Not reported for MrGV; the ICTV profile does not state whether ORF4 is present. No deposit exists.
